title: Goodyear Provides Corporate Update
summary: The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company (NASDAQ: GT) today announced that Roger Wood, a current member of the company's board of directors, has been appointed interim chief executive officer. Wood will lead the company while the board conducts a search for a permanent successor with a leading executive search firm. Mark Stewart will step down as chief executive officer and president and from the company's board of directors effective immediately.
